reviews.title: Quality for a bargain! Get it!
reviews.comment: It works great, cpu never gets anywhere near too hot even at max settings (5070ti if that matters). When everything is so expensive it’s nice to find a decent price on a quality device. It’s super quiet, the installation was like 8 screws and was pretty straightforward, pc pumps out cool air and the rgbs sync up with my other fans so controlling the lights is easy. Over all it looks nice and feels sturdy.

reviews.author: peter patterson

reviews.title: Works great, looks good
reviews.comment: Love this AIO cooler, very larger though.  Please be aware this is a little longer than just 360mm due to the return loop reservoirs on each end of the radiator. The fans are standard 120mm size, so times 3 makes it a 360... my purchased computer case didn't understand this marketing jargon and therefore advertised its ability to fit this massive automotive transmission radiator, uh, I mean CPU liquid cooler, in the spot with just over 360mm to to bottom... the intended place for Installation. Can't tell you one hundred percent, but I imagine most, if not all cpu coolers have their radiators protruding beyond the edges of the fans, meaning they take up a bit more space than the width of the fan encasements. After some modifications I manged to fit this beast under the hood and it works great, keeps my i7 4700k nice and cool, and man that intel chip can make some heat working under pressure, the air flowing out the side of my computer is undoubtedly warm, kinda like a little heater in here, but I'm glad I got it because I feel not only does it do the job but I imagine I probably get a few degrees knocked down versus the 240L version due to the larger size and heat dispersion. Just keep in mind the radiator is quite massive, larger than my RTX 4080 card, and that is huge (granted the 4090 is even thicker) this radiator is easily 20-30 percent longer and about a thick with fans installed. Installation was reasonably strait forward, the aRGB works good on my motherboard software, def good for the price I paid, totally recommend, I'm sure the 240 will be just as good overall as it seems about the same, only less hulkish, but probably more likely to fit in most cases. Coolermaster is awesome.
reviews.author: Eldy

reviews.title: Excellent Cooling and Clean ARGB Look
reviews.comment: Installed this Cooler Master MasterLiquid 360L Core on my build and the performance has been excellent. Temps dropped noticeably compared to my previous cooler, even under heavy load. The 360mm radiator does a great job keeping things stable without ramping up noise too much. The ARGB lighting looks clean and syncs easily with motherboard software. Installation was straightforward, and everything feels solid and well made. Great option if you’re looking for strong cooling performance with nice aesthetics.
reviews.author: Mason W

reviews.title: Nice improvement.
reviews.comment: Swapped out my 2 fan version of this aio to this one. It was a little difficult to install but I'm loving the end result. I have a rysen 9 5900x. The wiring was the most difficult part of the installation. I may have bent one of the RGB headers but it still works. The fit in the pc case was good but that's thanks to the extra space I had in my phanteks p500a case. The temperature improved going from the 2 fan version of the aio to this one. Only complaint is the thermal paste that comes with it. The viscosity is almost hard but it will spread with assistance. I'll change it out later. Overall the purchase and installation was worth it. Plus the price at the time was awesome.
